## Reading problem

What reading or text-handling problem are you trying to solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest interaction that would solve it.

## Why it belongs in Viewoupe

Explain why this should be part of the in-place reading layer rather than a general page editor or separate reader application.

## Privacy / permissions impact

Would this require storage, network access, browser permissions, or external services?
